[A737] TAKEN
Branch: 843-adopt-gptp-1616fc8f (from dev cc204c6fd2349b543d73f15c97162a2c4434c86e)
Authoritative references: #843 scope items 1 to 4 and its acceptance; Mister-M-alt/FPGA-gPTP #98 / PR #99 and #100 / PR #101 (main 1616fc8f062fbf58c35ad31674b5b233207bbdb8); IEEE 802.1AS-2011 8.6.2.3, 10.2.8.2.1, 10.2.9, 10.3.9.1, 11.4.1, 11.4.4.3; IEEE 1588-2008 7.6.2.5 Table 6; IEEE 1722.1-2021 6.2.2.8 and 7.2.8; Milan v1.2 4.2.6.2.3 and 4.2.6.2.6.
Interpreted scope: Move the gptp-processor gitlink from 135afd04 to 1616fc8f. The builder moves clock_accuracy from the engine-pinned set to the consumed set: each config's gptp.clock_accuracy is passed to the generator's --clock-accuracy, the AVB_INTERFACE descriptor states the same value, and the divergence refusal no longer applies to that field. The two AX7101 configs state 0x22 (the maintainer's decision); the three Arty configs state 0xFE (802.1AS-2011 8.6.2.3 b), uncharacterised oscillator). A config that omits the key resolves to 0xFE, which is what dev announces today. The builder comments at endstation_builder.py:3561, :4153, :4165-4168 (and the docstring at :3644-3649) are corrected. The ROM digests are re-recorded with syn/yosys/ooc.sh --record-rom-digests; the test_builder model-shape pins move only where the resolved clock_accuracy moves them. OUR_CQ in gptp_shadow and gptp_plane is taken from the generator the harness builds with. A builder gate builds a 0xFE config and a 0x22 config and requires that octet in the engine's Announce in the gPTP leg. Area and timing of the shipping route are measured against dev.
Known dependency: the stricter-readings page (item 4) is introduced by PR #842 and is not on dev cc204c6f. This lane does not create a second copy of it; it will publish the text the page needs and report item 4 against that dependency.
Validation plan: on a clean clone of the committed head: the full sweep as four shard units (scripts/run_all_suites.sh, --shard k/4); the firmware self-test; fw_coverage.py --check; sw/builder/test_builder.py --require-rv32; cd tests && behave; every run step of .github/workflows/docs.yml; scripts/docs_inventory.py --check; git diff --check against the merge base; the shipping route on dev and on the head, one directive.
Executor: [A737]. Reviewer: an independent cleared-context reviewer, to be named by the maintainer.
Blockers: none (item 4 dependency above)

[A737] REVIEW READY
Commit: 1105f54546b2f19d9577b7fad902c908e34f88ee (branch 843-adopt-gptp-1616fc8f, base dev cc204c6fd2349b543d73f15c97162a2c4434c86e; not pushed)
Changed:
- gptp-processor gitlink 135afd04 -> 1616fc8f (FPGA-gPTP #98/PR #99, #100/PR #101); ROM digest re-recorded by syn/yosys/ooc.sh --record-rom-digests; boundary and time-sync diagrams through their generators; donor links and pin row.
- Builder: gptp.clock_accuracy is consumed (GPTP_ENGINE_CONSUMED), passed by gptp_ucode_args() to --clock-accuracy and stated in AVB_INTERFACE; an omitted key is 0xFE (802.1AS-2011 8.6.2.3 b)); values outside IEEE 1588-2008 Table 6 are refused. The comments at endstation_builder.py:3561, :4153 and the refusal message no longer say "consumes only" or "announces this field from a constant".
- Configs: both AX7101 configs 0x22, the three Arty configs 0xFE. Arty hash pins unchanged (0xFE before and after); the AX7101 hash-derived ids move with the descriptor (no pin names them).
- Tests: builder gate 1b (a clockAccuracy change reaches the image), 26b (per-board descriptor bytes, omitted-key default), new 26c (a 0x22 and a 0xFE config each build the generator's image for their value; Table 6 refusals); the milan_dp gptp leg runs the AX7101 config's image and requires 0x22 in every DUT Announce, gptp-lat the Arty's and requires 0xFE; gptp_shadow and gptp_plane take OUR_CQ from the generator and grade it in the plane's own Announce. Eight planted mutants, each failing its check by name.
- fw_service_budget oracle re-measured on both AX7101 shapes and regenerated by gen_oracle.py (the flash media carries the new octet). Verdicts unchanged; the small timing drift in it is already on dev (dev re-measured gives the same figures).
- Records: CHANGELOG, SUBMODULES adoption record, AREA_BUDGET, regenerated docs inventory.
Validation (each on a clean clone of the commit above):
- Full sweep, 4 shard units (bash scripts/run_all_suites.sh <logs> --wait --shard k/4, MAKEFLAGS -j4 --no-print-directory, pinned Verilator 5.050): shards 0, 1, 3 exit 0 (15/15, 17/17, 16/16 suites; 361,125 / 1,525,512 / 21,575 checks). Shard 2 exited 92: capture_coherence timed out at its 2,400 s limit (UNKNOWN) while its 4 CPUs were shared with other gates; every other suite in it passed. Shard 2 re-run alone on 4 CPUs: exit 0, 17/17 suites, 284,230 checks, 0 timed out. 0 in-suite failures everywhere; preflight passed first time in every shard.
- milan_dp gptp: "[CA] 4 DUT Announce frame(s); last clockQuality 0xF822436A, expected clockAccuracy 0x22", 212/212; gptp-lat: "... 0xF8FE436A, expected clockAccuracy 0xFE", 212/212; gptp_shadow 326/326; gptp_plane 31/31; fw_service_budget 55 + 14 checks, 0 failures.
- python3 sw/firmware/nvm_hosttest/test_nvm_firmware.py --self-test: rc 0.
- python3 sw/firmware/gtest/fw_coverage.py --check --jobs 8: rc 0 (PASS, 30 files); --selftest: rc 0.
- python3 sw/builder/test_builder.py --require-rv32: rc 0, "ALL GATES PASS EXCEPT 2 NOT RUN" (gate 1b's MAKEFLAGS arm on this make; gate 11 needs a calibration tree not on this machine), as on dev.
- cd tests && behave: rc 0, 14 features, 508 scenarios, 2,330 steps.
- Every run: step of .github/workflows/docs.yml, each job on a fresh clone: verifier rc 0, 65 steps rc 0, 31 not run with a recorded reason, 0 bad.
- python3 scripts/docs_inventory.py --check: rc 0 (fresh); --selftest rc 0.
- git diff --check cc204c6fd2349b543d73f15c97162a2c4434c86e HEAD: rc 0.
- lint_rtl.py --check, check_em_dash.py, xvlog_gate.py --check: rc 0.
- Physical gPTP suite (make -C tb/verilator/milan_dp_gptp) at 4c4c5982, whose only difference from this head is the service oracle: rc 0, 151 + 6 + 20 + 14 + 14 checks, 0 failures.
- Eight planted mutants (builder, legs, harnesses), each failing its check by name.
Acceptance criteria:
- Sweep with milan_dp gptp and gptp-lat, gptp_shadow, gptp_plane, firmware self-test, builder, behave, docs gates green; docs inventory regenerated: met (above).
- A builder test with a 0xFE config and one with a 0x22 config each produce that value on the wire in the gPTP leg: met (gate 26c; milan_dp gptp 0x22, gptp-lat 0xFE, "[CA] 4 DUT Announce frame(s)").
- Area and timing of the shipping route recorded against dev: met (CHANGELOG, SUBMODULES, AREA_BUDGET). Route-1x1, shipping directive ExtraPostPlacementOpt only: dev cc204c6f 51,994 LUT / 54,101 FF / 15,841 slices / 13 DSP / WNS +0.236 ns / WHS +0.036 ns; this head 52,695 / 54,288 / 15,846 (4 of 15,850 free) / 15 / +0.018 ns / +0.015 ns; both routes complete, no failing endpoint.
- Required item 4 (stricter-readings page): NOT MET. The page is introduced by PR #842 and is not on dev; replacement text for its gPTP section is prepared for whichever lands second.
Open risks/questions:
1. Owner decision needed on the route: at this pin the slow corners reach +0.018 ns, under the +0.03 ns build floor, on the shipping directive (the only one routed, as assigned; #818 judges the best of three). The resource gate refuses the LUT (+683 over the record, tolerance 500), DSP (+2, tolerance 0) and WNS-floor rows. The worst path is the SoC's SDRAM controller, outside the gPTP engine and milan_datapath: placement pressure at 4 free slices from the engine's #100 growth (+2 DSPs for the TLV frequency multiply).
2. Item 4 depends on PR #842 (above).
3. ci/image/command-table.json is not regenerated: scripts/ci_tool_inventory.py --check already refuses on dev, and no PR gate runs it.
